source_request:
비 오는 밤, 막차가 떠나는 정류장에 혼자 남은 성인이 젖은 서류를 쥔 순간. 지나가던 사람이 급히 찍은 실사 사진. 버스를 놓친 사건과 인물의 낙담이 한 프레임에서 읽히게.

이걸로 아까와 같은 방법으로 하되 스킬 미사용 3개, 스킬 사용 3개 이미지 생성까지 진행하고 비교해줘. 프롬프트 비교도 진행하고 이미지 자체에 대한 비교도 진행해줘.
interpreted_intent: A hurried passerby photo catches one adult just after missing the final bus on a rainy night; the departure and their disappointment must be simultaneously legible.
subject: One stranded adult commuter holding wet documents
setting: A rain-soaked bus stop at night with the final bus leaving
event: The last bus departs while the commuter remains at the stop
visual_priorities: Clearly show the bus departing and the adult stranded in the same frame
Show wet documents and a visibly deflated emotional response
baseline_prompt_en: Photorealistic candid street photograph at a rain-soaked bus stop late at night. One stranded commuter, clearly an adult, is the only person left at the stop, caught in the missed-last-bus moment as the last bus is already pulling away from the curb in the same frame. The bus’s closed rear doors, receding tail lamps, and narrow spray behind its wheels make departure unmistakable; a small illuminated timetable on the shelter marks this as the final service. The commuter stands with both feet planted on the pavement just behind the curb, right hand gripping a bundle of wet documents at waist height; rain has softened their corners and streaked the ink. Their left arm hangs slack, shoulders fold inward, and the commuter’s face shows deflated disappointment as their eyes follow the bus. The grip, sodden pages, and face remain unobstructed. A passing pedestrian’s hurried photograph sets a slightly off-level, human-height viewpoint, as though a phone was lifted for one quick shot while walking by. Hold both the stranded adult and the departing bus legibly in one frame, with rain-wet reflections and imperfect motion blur at the edges, natural street lighting, and ordinary, unstaged clothing.
